Skills

Choose 4 of your 8 career skills and two of your four specialization skills; each takes one free rank. A skill on both lists can be picked twice to start at rank 2, the most you can begin with. After creation every rank costs XP, so these are the best ranks you will ever buy.

Starting experience may buy skill ranks now, to a maximum of rank 2. Every cost here is the published rule — five times the new rank, and five more if the skill is not on your career or specialization list.

A Rank Upgrades, It Does Not Add

Edge of the Empire p.20

The tag beside a skill (BR, AG, INT) is the characteristic it rolls, and it sets how many dice you throw. Each rank upgrades one of those green ability dice into a yellow proficiency die, which is a better die. It does not add one. A high characteristic and a rank beats a rank alone.

Brawn 4, Melee 0kkkk
Brawn 4, Melee 1lkkk
Brawn 4, Melee 2llkk
Brawn 2, Melee 2ll

Four dice with two upgraded beats two dice with two upgraded. The row never gets longer; it gets better.
